headline: Backlash Meets Buildout
thesis: As EdTech Week runs at Columbia, big-city AI pauses and student-protection reports collide with free AI-literacy training and data-standard rollouts.
summary: EdTech Week is under way at Teachers College, Columbia, with Day 1 centered on higher ed, workforce and early learning. EdSurge reports the backlash to classroom AI: New York City paused student-facing generative AI for about 600,000 students and Los Angeles pulled it from student devices. In higher ed, Inside Higher Ed covers reports that campus AI adoption is outpacing student protections. Meanwhile ISTE+ASCD's Google-backed AI-literacy training, Ed-Fi's statewide data hubs and 1EdTech's restructuring show the infrastructure side continuing to build. Several sources had no new dated items found today; those are noted below.
footnote: Compiled from 11 curated edtech sources · OCTOBER 15, 2026 · Direct site access was unavailable in this run, so items come from search results and may not be the very latest; evergreen items are noted as such.

themes.title: AI Value & Evidence
themes.body: Brookings' task force and its audit-first guidance keep pressing for proof before scale, including a field experiment where unrestricted ChatGPT use lowered later test scores.

themes.title: AI Policy & Backlash
themes.body: NYC's one-year pause and LA's device removal mark a turn toward restriction, even as most districts now have AI guidelines.

themes.title: Student Protection & Trust
themes.body: Reports flag that campus AI adoption outpaces student safeguards, and students fear false AI-cheating accusations.

themes.title: Teachers, Faculty & Students
themes.body: Teacher readiness lags: a third of teachers lack formal AI guidance, while free ISTE+ASCD/Google training targets six million educators.

themes.title: Standards & Interoperability
themes.body: 1EdTech restructures into a nonprofit plus consortium and Ed-Fi hubs show real-time data at statewide scale.

themes.title: Fall Events
themes.body: EdTech Week runs Oct 14–15 at Columbia, and ISTE's GenerationAI cohort convenes Oct 19–20.
